items.md: ## **SECOND NOTICE OF MODIFICATIONS TO TEXT OF PROPOSED REGULATIONS AND ADDITION OF DOCUMENTS TO RULEMAKING FILE**
items.value: SECOND NOTICE OF MODIFICATIONS TO TEXT OF PROPOSED REGULATIONS AND ADDITION OF DOCUMENTS TO RULEMAKING FILE

items.md: Pursuant to the requirements of Government Code section 11346.8(c), and section 44 of Title 1 of the California Code of Regulations, the Department of Motor Vehicles is providing a second notice of changes made to proposed regulations originally noticed to the public in the California Regulatory Notice Register on October 31, 2025, related to the Electronic Lien and Titling Program. A Notice of Modification was also provided to the public on April 23, 2026.
